LAG-QB10: You asked: is this Infinite Match? No. Infinite Match plays the real match nonstop and gets every fix automatically. Match Dev is Mikey's separate copy that gets no fixes. Since you're deciding all test pages yourself in the admin redesign, you can also answer ✎ "with the test pages".
ADM-Q1: You asked: why? These 26 pages save things everyone shares: scenarios, lineups, club data, patch notes, the XP book. The server already refuses those saves from anyone who isn't an admin, so a tester there sees buttons that fail when tapped. Two of them also show real-match data (StatsBomb) we aren't licensed to show in a paid game. Testers keep the 43 pages where they can actually play and test.
